claims.statement: Project Marinus is ramping up construction activities across Tasmania and Victoria after financial close and approvals; Stage 1 is a 750 MW two-way interconnector.
Marinus Link has crossed from financed network option into physical construction, increasing the probability of future bidirectional transfer capacity without creating operating capacity today.
September LNG shipments through Hormuz reached 19 according to S&P Global and 21 according to Kpler, versus 15 in June, while some Qatar-linked vessels continued dark transits.
Higher LNG throughput indicates adaptation to the Hormuz constraint rather than restoration of the pre-war navigation regime.
European governments discussed a French proposal to release 50 million barrels of diesel from strategic stocks while IEA members considered an additional 50 million barrels of crude.
Strategic-stock pressure is migrating toward refined products even as some primary Gulf crude and LNG flows recover.
Gas Malaysia targets a final investment decision in the second half of 2027 for a Kedah LNG terminal with capacity of up to 6 mtpa and completion around 2030.
The Kedah project would create an alternative LNG import and supplier route for northern Malaysia, but remains an option until FID.
